scope: Original saved CSV excerpts only; no new trials or solver evaluations.
interpretation_notes: cycle_raw.mf_probability_sum stores nominal stagewise sums, not per-feature values or candidate affine probabilities.
pose_sdf records pre-control pose; trial_history records post-update pose.
Covariance stage rows are reconstructed candidate solver trajectory values; safe-stop rows describe a constructed plan.
No p_affine, per-feature probability, feature gradient, A_mf, c_mf, or candidate affine residual columns occur in the four original CSV types.
validation: Every extracted row was checked against the original CSV; csv_line includes the header.
